name: We Are*
source:
Yuuya's summer life is overturned by 4 girls, 2 of which possess special powers and small wings that occasionally appear on their wrists.

(from [url=http://myanimelist.net/manga/10824/We/Are_Cruel_Angels]MyAnimeList[/url])
translation:
悠也的暑假生活被四名少女徹底顛覆，其中兩人擁有特殊力量，手腕上偶爾還會冒出小小的翅膀。

（摘自[url=http://myanimelist.net/manga/10824/We/Are_Cruel_Angels]MyAnimeList[/url]）
